summary: Verified header-overlap bug fix in AdminLayout/WorkerLayout on mobile viewport (390x844) and desktop regression (1920x800). All admin pages (/admin, /admin/workers, /admin/tasks, /admin/announcements) and worker pages (/worker, /worker/announcements) render H1 headings clearly below the fixed mobile top bar + nav pills stack. Regression smoke tests for admin Workers edit dialog and Announcements edit buttons all pass.

mobile_390x844.verdict: All H1s clear the fixed bar stack — no overlap

desktop_1920x800.verdict: Expected — desktop has no fixed top bar (sidebar-only), spacer is md:hidden. No overlap.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Header-overlap fix (spacer moved inside <main> with height calc(104px + var(--safe-top))) verified on mobile 390x844. Desktop shows H1 top=72px which is expected because AdminLayout on md+ uses a fixed left sidebar (no fixed top bar). No further UI issues found in the tested surfaces.
